Private function inserting a new holder into the sorted linked list and incrementing holdersCount.
Private function unlinking a holder, zeroing its balance and decrementing holdersCount.
Public function returning the first k holders by traversing _nextHolders.
Public function returning the n-th holder by traversing _nextHolders.
Internal function that updates a holder's balance in place when ordering is preserved, otherwise removes and re-adds the holder.
Internal view verifying that newValue fits between prevHolder and nextHolder in the sorted list.
Internal view scanning the linked list for the index where newValue should be inserted.
Internal view checking whether who is the successor of prev in the linked list.
Internal view scanning the linked list for the predecessor of who.
Private function selecting a pseudo-random holder from a keccak256 hash of block data and calling getTopHolder.
Internal recursive quicksort over an int array using signed pivot arithmetic.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, minting, approvals and the randomness seed.
Block timestamp (now) used for the tax start and the randomness seed.
Pseudo-random holder chosen from keccak256(now, block.difficulty, msg.sender), which is miner/validator manipulable.

Signed integer pivot arithmetic arr[uint(left + (right - left) / 2)] and loop index arithmetic in quickSort.
Raw a*b, a+b and a-b computations inside SafeMath checked only by assert statements.

newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership and the OwnershipTransferred event.

SafeMath.add performs a+b guarded only by an assert.
SafeMath.sub performs a-b guarded by assert(b<=a).
Token constructor mints the supply to msg.sender.
Token constructor calls addHolder for msg.sender.

Block timestamp flows into the _beginTax assignment.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a parameter used only by transferOwnership to update the owner state variable.
spender is a parameter used only as the allowance key inside approve.
amount is a parameter stored into _allowances and emitted by approve.
to is a parameter consumed by transfer before delegation to _transferFrom.
value is a parameter consumed by transfer before delegation to _transferFrom.
from is a parameter used only by transferFrom for balance and allowance checks.
start is a parameter used only by setTax to write _beginTax.
k is a parameter bounding the traversal loop of getTopHolders.
n is a parameter controlling the traversal count of getTopHolder.
who is a parameter identifying the holder inserted by addHolder.
balance is a parameter written into _balances by addHolder.
newBalance is a parameter applied by _updateBalance.
random_local is a local holding the tax recipient inside _transferFrom.
tax_local is the local produced by the tax arithmetic expression in _transferFrom.
mod_local is the local range used in the modulo operation that can divide by zero.
randomIndex_local is a local derived and used only within _getRandomHolder.
randomSeed_local is the manipulable keccak256 seed of the random selection.
quickSort_i is a loop local of the quickSort function.
quickSort_j is a loop local of the quickSort function.
quickSort_pivot is the value produced by the signed pivot arithmetic.
currentAddress is a traversal local of getTopHolders iterating the holder list.
